description: This PHP source file defines the class 'Cron' within the Opencart administrative marketplace controller namespace. The class handles various operations related to marketplace cron jobs, including listing, running, enabling, disabling, and deleting crons. It interacts with models for data manipulation and views for rendering the interface, providing CRUD functionality and JSON API responses for these cron jobs.

classes.name: Cron
classes.description: Controller class for managing marketplace cron jobs within the Opencart admin panel. Provides methods for listing, viewing, running, enabling, disabling, and deleting crons.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that loads the cron list view with data, including sorting, pagination, and breadcrumb navigation.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the view for the cron jobs list with current filtering and sorting applied.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates HTML for the list of crons based on current filter, sort, and pagination parameters.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes a specific cron job or processes a batch of cron jobs via AJAX, returning success or error JSON responses.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables a specific cron job via AJAX call, setting its status to active.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables a specific cron job via AJAX call, setting its status to inactive.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specific cron job via AJAX call.
